Context: Rates of Conveyance Allowance for Non-CHS doctors*.:-

- (vii) In case the conveyance is not maintained or is not available for use, owing to its being out of order or is not used for official journeys/ hospital visit for any other reason, for a period of more than 15 days at a time, Conveyance Allowance will be admissible during such period at the rate prescribed in 2 (iii) above.
